fields.event_name: International conference on the use of space technology for water resources management
fields.description: The conference will focus on the use of space technology for water resources management, including the monitoring of water quality, quantity and distribution, as well as the impact of climate change on water resources.

fields.event_name: International conference on artificial intelligence and education
fields.description: The conference will focus on the use of artificial intelligence in education, including the development of AI-powered learning tools, the ethical implications of AI in education, and the impact of AI on teaching and learning.

provenance.text_quote: International conference on artificial intelligence and education

fields.description: The World Engineering Day for Sustainable Development is an annual event that celebrates the role of engineering in sustainable development. The event will include a series of workshops, seminars and networking events.

fields.event_name: International conference on the ethics of neurotechnology
fields.description: The conference will focus on the ethical implications of neurotechnology, including the use of brain-computer interfaces, neuroimaging, and neurostimulation. The event will bring together experts from a range of disciplines to discuss the ethical, legal and social implications of neurotechnology.
